description.value: Select Pizza is a carry-out pizza restaurant specializing in Punjabi-style pizzas loaded with fresh toppings, blending South Asian flavours — tandoori chicken, paneer, butter chicken sauce — with familiar pizza formats. The North Delta location on 120 Street (Scott Road) is the OSM-mapped site, with a second location in Newton. The menu spans more than 20 specialty pizzas plus a build-your-own option.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Select Pizza is an active carry-out pizza business; the OSM-mapped address 8434 Scott Road corresponds to the North Delta location listed on the website as 8434 120 Street — Scott Road and 120 Street are the same road in Surrey BC, a street-name variant rather than a wrong location. The website prominently advertises carry-out/pickup ordering and labels multiple menu items as vegetarian, but makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill facilities.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '8434 Scott Road' while the website lists '8434 120 Street Surrey, BC V3W 7S2' for the North Delta location. Scott Road and 120 Street are the same road in Surrey BC, so this is likely a street-name variant, but the postal address should be verified.
Phone number absent from OSM; 604-591-3344 sourced from website for the North Delta location.
Carry-out only business with no confirmed seating, washrooms, or cyclist-specific amenities on website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Select Pizza is a legitimate operating food business where cyclists could pick up a meal, but none of the core WWC amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are confirmed from the website, and the carry-out-only model means washroom access is uncertain.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly labels multiple vegetarian pizzas: Vegetarian, Vegetarian Tandoori Chicken, Hot Paneer, Spinach Special, Shahi Paneer (Vegetarian), Veggie Lovers (Vegetarian), Mild Tandoori Paneer (Vegetarian). No vegan or gluten-free options mentioned
